2609.21386.title: AgentVidBench: A Multi-Hop Video Question Answering Benchmark for Evaluating MLLM Agents
2609.21386.paper_summary: Comprehensive video understanding is crucial for advancing artificial intelligence toward the intricate dynamics of the physical world. While recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in video understanding, existing benchmarks remain confined to simple scene-level queries or global summaries that require only single-step inference. Real-world video understanding involves more challenging tasks that require multi-hop multimodal reasoning, and there is a critical absence of video benchmarks equipped to rigorously evaluate these agentic capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentVidBench, a multi-hop video question answering benchmark focused on evaluating the spatial, temporal, and causal reasoning capabilities of MLLM agents. Beyond standard question-answer pairs, AgentVidBench provides step-by-step solution traces to support trajectory evaluation that assesses whether agents explicitly acquire the evidence needed to justify their answers. Experiments with 12 proprietary and open-source MLLMs show that single-turn performance remains limited on AgentVidBench, while integrating these models into state-of-the-art agentic workflows generally improves performance with respect to both accuracy and trajectory scores. We further present a simple yet effective agentic strategy that serves as a competitive baseline on AgentVidBench, establishing our benchmark as a holistic testbed for future research on agentic video understanding. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/krafton-ai/agentvidbench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/agentvidbench/agentvidbench.
2609.21386.paper_summary_zh: 全面的視頻理解對於推動人工智慧向物理世界的複雜動態發展至關重要。儘管最近在多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）方面的進展已顯示出在視頻理解中的卓越能力，但現有的基準仍然局限於簡單的場景級查詢或僅需單步推理的全局摘要。現實世界中的視頻理解涉及更具挑戰性的任務，這些任務需要多跳的多模態推理，而目前缺乏能夠嚴格評估這些代理能力的視頻基準。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了AgentVidBench，一個專注於評估MLLM代理的空間、時間和因果推理能力的多跳視頻問答基準。除了標準的問答對，AgentVidBench還提供逐步解決方案跟蹤，以支持評估代理是否明確獲取了證據來證明其答案的軌跡評估。對12個專有和開源的MLLM進行的實驗顯示，在AgentVidBench上的單輪性能仍然有限，而將這些模型整合到最先進的代理工作流程中通常能改善準確性和軌跡分數的表現。我們進一步提出了一種簡單但有效的代理策略，作為AgentVidBench上的競爭基準，確立了我們的基準作為未來代理視頻理解研究的整體測試平台。代碼和數據集可在 https://github.com/krafton-ai/agentvidbench 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/agentvidbench/agentvidbench 獲得。
